attribution: USDA Farm Production and Conservation Business Center, Geospatial Enterprise Operations (NAIP). Source files from the NAIP on AWS open data buckets maintained by Esri.
blockers: Source Cooperative account verification is not recorded
canonical publication status is candidate, not prepared or published

independent_maintainer_proposal.relationship: new Source Cooperative product proposal; immutable package metadata is unchanged

license_note: NAIP imagery is produced by the USDA Farm Production and Conservation Business Center and is in the public domain. USDA asks for credit; these files are a format conversion, not a USDA product.
limitations: Display copy only. The files hold red, green and blue as lossy JPEG at quality 65, with overviews at quality 75 and colour at half resolution. The near-infrared band and the lossless pixels stay in s3://naip-analytic.
Four Pennsylvania 2024 files carry a 2010 flight date in their names, as they do in the source.
The index at stac/naip.parquet lists only Utah 2024, New Hampshire 2025, Rhode Island 2025 and Vermont 2025 so far.
There are no overview files above the quad yet. A view wider than a few quads opens one file per quad.
Adjacent quarter quads overlap, as they do in the source.

review_context.status_basis: canonical publication status plus local manifest/snapshot hashes; this tool does not rerun scientific or public-host validation

summary: RGB JPEG Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs of USDA NAIP quarter quads for the state-years that the AWS naip-visualization bucket does not hold, converted from the naip-analytic MRF files with the same settings, file names and key layout.
temporal_note: One file per quarter quad per state-year. Each file name ends in the date it was flown. Utah 2024 was flown from 2024-06-23 to 2024-08-31.
title: NAIP display copies, 2024 onward
